author: Umesh Dahal
review_text: I have been using eSewa more than 5 years. I used to love using this app. Because it had initiated digital wallet very first in Nepal. But now, I am very disappointing😞 with eSewa. So, created Prabhu Pay and Khalti account yesterday. eSewa has reduced cash back on Topup, Airlines ticketing and other transactions in competitive market too. I think, Khalti & Prabhu pay will challenge eSewa soon in digital payment world because of its ego being "First Digital Wallet in Nepal"
